# Biorxiv fixtures

Detail-page metadata and a named JATS attachment selected by date range/server/cursor.

Adapted from the MIT-licensed [open-arrow-access v0.1.0 service tests](https://github.com/dentiny/open-arrow-access/tree/v0.1.0/service/tests) and its `biorxiv` fixture data. Local payloads are reduced/synthetic adaptations.

[http.json](http.json) defines response routes and synthetic authentication. Route syntax and loopback commands are documented in the [test guide](../../test/README.md#native-http-fixtures).
